description: Search community threads by keyword in titles, bodies and replies for first-hand reports (not the tool catalog; for that use search_tools). Example: {"query":"Twilio auth"}. Limit 1–20, default 10.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous search_questions response; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of threads to return, integer 1–20, default 10.

query.description: Keyword search over thread titles, bodies and replies (not the tool catalog).

tool.description: Catalog slug of a related tool

name: search_questions
